title: a chart packet deposits by value, so a far box's deposit lands at codemother
intention: codemother's deposit verb takes a chart packet by value (body.packet with body.name), berths it under her own instance-space and lands it; with body.scratch an orient packet lands in a scratch nexus minted on her side and dropped before the reply. A far box's deposit therefore reaches her, and e8fe361a5b2f's real-deposit tooth is green from any box.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus, whose bus home is akiendelllinux: e8fe361a5b2f's a_real_deposit_rides_the_bus reds 'no berthed orient packet under /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets to deposit'. Codemother berths packets on the Dell, and her deposit verb refuses any berth path not on her own disk, so a path sent from another box can never land.
traces_to: One bus per instance, with a device reached over it from every box (outline 11.3.5.1 context), and Law 1: a deposit lane that works only on the home box costs a lane.
how: shim.py _handle_deposit gains the by-value form: a bare stage-prefixed .json name and a dict packet are written to address.instance_path('codemother', 0)/'deposits'/<name>, then deposit_berth runs on that path. body.scratch (orient only) wraps the deposit in tree.scratch_nexus(scratch, owner='codemother'). The path form is unchanged. A red-first proof drives CodeMotherDevice in process with a stub embed bus. e8fe's tooth 4 sends a fixture orient packet by value with scratch.

clauses.claim: the deposit verb over body {packet, name}, with no file on codemother's side, berths the packet as <name> under codemother's instance deposits dir and lands it; the reply is accepted and names a node
with body.scratch, the orient packet lands in a codemother scratch nexus minted on codemother's side, the reply names that nexus, and its table does not exist once the reply is back
a name carrying a path separator or no known stage prefix, a packet that is not an object, or scratch with a non-orient name is refused naming the lack, and nothing is berthed
e8fe361a5b2f's a_real_deposit_rides_the_bus sends a fixture orient packet by value with scratch, and runs green from akienasus once the home box's codemother runs this build

decisions.text: D1: _handle_deposit accepts {packet, name, scratch?} beside {berth, nexus?}; codemother berths a by-value packet under her own instance deposits dir; scratch is honoured for orient only.
D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause 1-3, in process with a stub embed bus; names prefixed testing-.
D3: e8fe361a5b2f's tooth 4 sends a fixture orient packet by value with scratch, in place of reading a live berth from this box.
